 03. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is the 2nd successive bail application U/S.483 of BNSS, 2023 by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Tarasing P.S. Case No.75 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.37 of 2023 pending in the file of learned Ad-hoc Addl. District & Sessions Judge (FTSC) under POCSO Act,
Berhampur (GM), for commission of offences punishable U/Ss.376(3)/376(2)(n)/506 of IPC r/w.
Section 6 of the POCSO Act, on the main allegation of committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon the victim aged about less than 16 years.

3. Heard, Ms. Sujata Dash, learned counsel for the Petitioner and Mr. P. Satpathy, learned Addl.
Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record.
None appears for the victim despite being duly informed as apprised by the State.

4. In this bail application, bail is sought for to the petitioner primarily on the ground of false implication, but there is allegation against the petitioner for committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon the victim, who is stated to be aged about less than 16 years as on the date of occurrence.

In such view of the matter and after having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of offences as alleged against the petitioner vis--vis the allegations sought to be brought against him and the materials collected in support thereof and on going through the other materials placed on record together with the evidence of the victim and the DNA profiling report, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
